label: oracle-assisted navigation replay
instructions: Verify the frozen file set and SHA-256 hashes before indexing and each task; verify them again after replay.
Search using the frozen task query. Count the first search toward both result-page and tool-call limits.
Use relevance labels to select overlapping metadata hits in returned rank order. Record this selection as oracle-assisted.
Read selected immutable handles using show. Follow only returned show continuations; never substitute a current-path read.
When the task requires ctx, request ctx for a selected handle. Require a successful complete context response with a nonempty relationship list.
Follow search-result continuations with more when selected source candidates are exhausted, subject to three total result pages.
Credit source evidence only for complete successful responses with matching selected revisions and emitted original bytes covering the full labeled span.
Stop on complete source evidence and required context, exhaustion, three result pages, or eight tool calls.
Preserve misses, incomplete delivery, elapsed time, bytes, observed costs, and censoring; never infer unknown token counts or task success.
